castTime.binNote: Bin's LilliaE castTime is 0.35, disagreeing with the wiki's stated 0.4; wiki's value is reported.

mechanics.claim: The seed detonates on hitting an enemy or terrain, dealing damage in a cone to enemies near the impact.
mechanics.quote: the seed detonates upon hitting an enemy or terrain while on the ground, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies in a cone

mechanics.claim: Spell shields do not stop the seed from detonating and striking nearby targets.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} does not prevent the seed from detonating thus striking nearby targets.

mechanics.claim: Projectile-destroying effects can make the rolling seed detonate early upon collision, dealing 0 damage to the target that destroyed it and not triggering the cone AoE.
mechanics.quote: If {{cai|Unbreakable|Braum}} blocks the initial projectile, it is destroyed and deals 0 damage to him, as well as not triggering the cone-shaped area of effect.
